title: The Leaf That Wouldn't Stay
visual_prompt: A sunny miniature woodland clearing with the genuine Blender Studio Sprite and Elder Sprite characters, fresh grass, moss and tiny rounded pebbles, a shallow natural leaf-collection area, a small acorn cap, one forked twig, and gently visible breezes. Soft warm morning light, luminous 1K Poly Haven HDRI, coherent first-party Blender Studio stylized textures, warm blue-green shadows, gentle expressive eye-lines. Keep recognizably original silhouettes. 16:9, 720p/24fps, clean medium-close framing, purposeful cuts and subtle camera movement, no generic replacements.

dialogue.speaker: sprite
dialogue.text: Pebble wall! Nothing gets past this.

dialogue.speaker: sprite
dialogue.text: Ha! The acorn cap will stop you.

dialogue.speaker: elder_sprite
dialogue.text: Look at the grass. Which way is it bending?

dialogue.speaker: sprite
dialogue.text: Then my leaf needs somewhere to dance.

shots.title: Instant leafy moustache
shots.blocking: Sprite pops out of the bush with one enormous leaf stuck across the nose; leaf flutters like a moustache. No establishing shot.

shots.title: Keep still!
shots.blocking: Sprite lowers prized leaf into a neat three-leaf collection. Its stem shivers, then the leaf scoots away as Sprite reaches.

shots.title: An adventurous leaf
shots.blocking: Elder Sprite watches the leaf slide while Sprite chases one step too far and gently lands in a soft grass tuft.

shots.title: The mighty pebble wall
shots.blocking: Sprite lines up three little rounded pebbles. Wind lifts the leaf over the small wall; Sprite proudly points at the empty spot.

shots.title: Under the gap
shots.blocking: Wind nudges leaf under a gap. An unsuspecting pebble rolls harmlessly toward Sprite's foot; Sprite hops and glances to Elder.

shots.title: The acorn lid
shots.blocking: Sprite drops an empty acorn cap above the leaf. Breeze blows the cap like a tiny umbrella while the leaf remains loose.

shots.title: The wrong nose
shots.blocking: Loose leaf lands across Elder Sprite's nose. Elder freezes with an accidental magnificent moustache. Sprite snorts with laughter.

shots.title: Notice the grass
shots.blocking: A ripple moves across the meadow grass and a light dangling frond. Elder points downwind; Sprite notices what the leaf is doing.

shots.title: A place to dance
shots.blocking: Sprite gently loops the leaf stem around a forked twig beside the collection. It can pivot freely in the breeze but cannot fly away.

shots.title: The leaf spinner
shots.blocking: The tethered leaf spins like a miniature windmill. Sprite copies it with delighted little turns, almost wobbling over.

shots.title: A new tree
shots.blocking: The leaf rotates and bops Elder Sprite on the nose again. Elder is perfectly still. Both burst into giggles; immediate clean cut.
